description: Defines data models for a quiz application including classes for Quiz and QuizQuestion with JSON serialization methods.

classes.name: Quiz
classes.description: Represents a quiz with multiple questions, including fields for id, title, description, and a list of questions.

classes.name: QuizQuestion
classes.description: Represents a single question within a quiz, including prompt, options, correct answer index, and optional explanation.

methods.name: Quiz.fromJson
methods.description: Factory constructor that creates a Quiz instance from a JSON map.

methods.name: QuizQuestion.fromJson
methods.description: Factory constructor that creates a QuizQuestion instance from a JSON map.
